jobs.prompt: Precise snout-only anatomy edit of IMAGE 1, the existing Odin sprite. Make the muzzle modestly shorter and more compact, approximately10-15% less nose-to-mouth/cheek projection, so the nose and round whisker pads sit naturally close to the face as in the real photo. Keep the exact existing neutral forward gaze. Preserve eye positions and pupil/expression exactly (healthy green eye and smaller injured brown eye must stay distinct), existing head outer envelope/size/location, ears, whiskers, skull shape and chin width. Change only the nose/bridge/mouth/whisker-pad projection; do NOT shrink the whole head, change eye spacing or make a flat-faced Persian. Mouth closed and neutral, no smiling or upturned lips. Keep exact existing1254x1254 canvas, body and all fur texture, paws, tail and compressed underside at identical locations. No added shaggy spikes, no airbrush, no new torso stripes. Actual compact ear pinnae with sparse wispy extensions unchanged. Preserve all transparent margins, no cropping. Body and tail keep the existing horizontal support plane, only existing paws overhang. Transparent background, no floor/shadow/props/text, no edge glow or matte.
